kamloops.title: Why information officer kept camera rolling even as he fled B.C. wildfire with family
kamloops.description: When Erick Thompson decided he had to flee with his family as a wildfire roared towards Summerland, B.C., around 1:40 a.m. on Saturday, he also knew he had to keep filming.

kamloops.title: Evacuees slowly learn of losses from B.C. wildfire that forced thousands to flee
kamloops.description: Kyla Gaudiuso says she found out her home in Faulder, B.C., had been destroyed when she received a photo of the ridge where it once stood, completely engulfed in flames.

kamloops.title: 80-year-old woman dies while fleeing aggressive Bald Range fire near Summerland
kamloops.description: Penticton RCMP said the Meadow Valley resident was attempting to leave her home with one member of her family when she reportedly died suddenly.

kamloops.title: Feds approve assistance to help B.C. fire evacuees with shelter
kamloops.description: Some wildfire evacuees in Penticton, B.C. reported having long wait times to register for assistance, with those who were interviewed saying they waited more than 14 or 15 hours.

kamloops.title: Video captures Faulder residents rescuing their dogs from vehicle surrounded by flames
kamloops.description: A video has surfaced online that captures the dramatic moments when Faulder residents were trying to rescue their dogs from a vehicle that was surrounded by flames.

kamloops.title: ‘Explosive’ Summerland wildfire creating conditions ‘never seen before’
kamloops.description: The BC Wildfire Service says it is one of the most challenging fires this province has ever faced, involving helicopter rescues of dozens of people trapped behind the fire line.

kamloops.title: As massive B.C. wildfire raged, groups worked to rescue livestock, animals
kamloops.description: When the Bald Range wildfire sparked near Summerland on Friday afternoon, thousands of residents prepared to leave their homes. But many have livestock and animals to care for.
